body:
Found by the #610 datum work (PR #793), reported there as a lead decision; filing it so it is tracked.

`tests/test_msl_sheet_threading.py::test_o1_no_sheet_identity_vs_13de212_golden` went **red on CI on 2026-08-24** (job 97349946815, max deviation 2.505e-06 against the golden). The golden was captured on a jax 0.8.x machine; CI runs jax 0.6.2. That is the same platform-vs-code ambiguity #610 exists to make diagnosable: a 2.5e-6 deviation on a float32 identity is consistent with a BLAS/XLA version difference, but nothing on record says it is not a code change.

Do not loosen the golden's tolerance to green it. Acceptance: re-capture the golden at a pinned platform identity (CPU / OS / jax / numpy / BLAS / dtype recorded next to it, the way `tests/fixtures/msl_z0_length_invariance/platform_datums.json` now does), and either (i) show the 2.5e-6 reproduces as pure platform variance at a fixed commit, or (ii) find the commit that moved it.

comments.body: 닫습니다. 편차를 보이던 테스트 자체가 없어졌습니다. #931(`a96c23f7`, 2026-09-07, main에는 09-10 머지)이 `test_o1_no_sheet_identity_vs_13de212_golden`을 `test_o1_no_sheet_identity_vs_931_golden`으로 바꾸고 golden을 이 트리가 만드는 board에서 다시 캡처했으며(`golden_msl_sheet_thread_{s,freqs}_931.npy`, 캡처 스크립트 `tests/unit/sparams/_results_931/capture_msl_sheet_thread_golden.py`), 옛 13de212 golden은 그 docstring에 출처와 날짜로만 남습니다. #940이 9월 7일 실행(main `60d88c34`, #931 머지 전)에서 본 2.5e-6은 옛 golden에 대한 것입니다. jax 버전 간 편차를 일반적으로 다루는 자리는 #796(플랫폼 datum 귀속)입니다.

title: test_msl_sheet_threading golden red on CI 2026-08-24 (2.5e-6, jax 0.8.x golden vs jax 0.6.2 CI) — platform or code?
